notes: No Greek article stands anywhere in the verse: every dative is an anarthrous substantival adjective or noun, so under rule 58's substantival clause each takes its own supplied determiner along with the 'for' realizing the dative case.
s004 dikaio heads on 'righteous' and not on the supplied generic 'man', which is rule 17's generic-noun clause as rule 102 scopes it to anarthrous Greek.
s018 and s020 head on 'murderers', the word glossing the -loias element of each compound, with the case preposition riding along under rule 21's determinerless clause.
